def factor_volume_persistence_continuous(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    persistence = vol_ratio.rolling(40, min_periods=20).mean()
    df_copy["factor_volume_persistence_continuous"] = persistence
    return df_copy["factor_volume_persistence_continuous"]
formula: Rolling mean of continuous volume ratio (volume/EMA) over 40 days from 20-day volume classification.
rationale: Mutates parent by replacing the binary high-volume regime flag with the continuous volume ratio from classify_volume_regime, capturing intensity rather than just frequency of high-volume states. The 40-day averaging window preserves the core persistence intuition while being more responsive than 60 days. This targets improved timeliness and signal granularity.
